cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Approve the Harmless Version
cards.instruction: Get approval for a harmless version of your plan, then gradually reveal what that approval now commits them to.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. May I put one extra chair in the hall? Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Excellent. It's for the chair of my new tenants' committee.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I approved furniture, not a committee.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then welcome to our first agenda item: what your chair authorises.
